title: Web server OOM kill without restart
reason: Where and what correctly identify the web container OOM crash, but why mistakenly attributes the cause to an API deploy rather than the temporary memory spike.
root_cause: The web (nginx) container was killed by a SIGKILL (exit code 137) after exceeding its 256 MiB memory limit, likely due to increased load from the api 2.3.1 deploy three days ago; host memory and disk space are ample.
truth: The web container was killed by the OOM killer due to a temporary memory spike, and because it has no restart policy, it remained stopped.
